reviews.text: You can bring your dog into the store on the 5th floor, near the center, via the elevator in the South Building of Grand Front Osaka, provided it is properly concealed in a cart. The store has a huge selection of products and is very enjoyable. There were lots of LANCO products. The variety of collars, harnesses, and leashes is amazing. The staff were all smiling and very kind.
I bought a lot of cat toys and collars. The store staff were very nice and explained everything carefully.

We purchased the legendary cat groomer from this store. And it turns out to be one of the best gift we can give our little baby! He totally loves it.

We also bought a few toys for him. Nice shop helpful staff members.

I came from Aichi and stayed overnight for the Expo. I had some time before my friend arrived, so I went in just to do some window shopping.

But! The shop staff started talking to me and were incredibly kind and helpful, explaining the pros and cons of each item. I ended up wanting to buy a lot! (laughs)
I'm usually not good at being approached by sales staff, but I had a really enjoyable time. I've been happy and satisfied since the moment I arrived in Osaka! I'm so glad I made such a wonderful memory, thank you so much! I hope this message reaches that lady!

By the way, they had so many different kinds of cute things, and lots of interesting new items. I'm looking forward to giving souvenirs to my child!

I want to go again!!
It was a shop specializing in dogs and cats, and there was no aquarium section.

That day I was poorly dressed and didn't even wear makeup, but a kind elderly male employee at the store started chatting with me and recommending leashes. Even though we didn't understand each other, I could feel his thoughtfulness. A female employee handled the payment; she was polite and reserved. I forgot my receipt, so she ran to get it for me at the front of the store. The store isn't big, but it has a huge selection of products—so many to choose from! The prices are also very reasonable compared to my country. Next time I fly to Osaka, I'll definitely shop there again, because I have a cute dog waiting for me at home.
